tool.name: PanExpr focal-loop differential expression
tool.description: multi-strain, host-virus DE with tie-preserving EM and a byte-budget stop gate
tool.command: focaloop run --blueprint '$__tool_directory__/blueprint.focaloop.yml' --targets '$targets' --sample-sheet '$sample_sheet' --reads #for $r in $reads '$r' #end for --read-ids #for $r in $reads '$r.element_identifier' #end for --contrast '$contrast_a:$contrast_b' #if $priors --priors '$priors' #end if --max-bytes \$(( $max_mb * 1048576 )) --state-dir focaloop_state --state-archive '$state' --out-table '$de_table' --out-telemetry '$telemetry'

param.name: targets
param.label: Target catalog (FASTA)
param.help: Header attributes group=, assembly=, kind=, kingdom= drive tie grouping

param.name: sample_sheet
param.label: Sample sheet
param.help: Header: sample, condition[, batch]; sample must equal the read dataset name (extension stripped)

param.name: reads
param.label: Single-end reads, one dataset per sample

param.name: priors
param.label: External log-priors
param.help: target_id, log_prior_weight[, group_id, sample, modality, confidence, source_uri]

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs the `panexpr` focal loop. FASTQ blocks are streamed until the stop gate decides that more bytes no longer change the answer. A 28,000-read kernel tournament (25,000 real reads + 5 regimes x 600 synthetic reads) picks the mapping kernel; kernels that collapse more than 20% of strain/paralog ties are disqualified. Multi-strain placement is resolved by backward EM and group-level log2 fold changes are reported.
-----
**Inputs**
- *Target catalog*: transcripts / gene bodies from every strain, release and host/virus assembly. - *Sample sheet*: `sample`, `condition`, optional `batch`; `sample` must match the read dataset names. - *Reads*: one FASTQ per sample. - *Priors*: optional cross-modal log-priors (WGS copy number, proteomics, chromatin).
-----
**Outputs**
- *DE table*: log2FC, SE, Wald p, BH-adjusted p and placement-variance fraction per group. - *Telemetry*: tournament scoreboard, per-iteration gate metrics and `trap_codes`. - *Warm state*: Zstd-Parquet state archive for zero-byte follow-up queries.
The job fails (exit code 3) when an abort trap fires: `LOW_MAP_RATE`, `TIE_SYMMETRY_FAIL` or `CONFOUNDED_DESIGN`.
